What’s not in this inventory?
Okta WIC · V1 protected-object catalog

The tree lists every object type the V1 catalog protects. Okta objects you may know from the Admin Console that aren’t tree items fall into the groups below.

Protected — reached through their parent item

Sub-structures of an item, not navigation destinations. Open the parent to browse and restore them.

  • User Schema — inside User Types
  • App User Schemas — inside Applications
  • Policy Rules — inside Policies
  • Scopes & Claims — inside Authorization Servers
  • Relationships (group memberships, app & policy assignments, resource-set bindings, principal roles) — shown on the item instances they connect
Deferred — planned for a future version (14)

Restorable, but rated low-value by the classification study. Not yet captured.

  • Customizations — Brands, Brand Themes, Custom Domains, Email Templates & Customizations
  • Authenticators & Authenticator Methods
  • ThreatInsight Config & Zone Exclusions · Behavior Rules
  • Trusted Origins · Hooks · Org & Org Factors
Dropped — report-only, no restore possible (7)

Backup can’t deliver a restore for these — secret material is never returned by Okta, or the object is enrollment-owned.

  • Devices & User Devices
  • App Signing Keys · API Tokens
  • Directory Connectors · Agent Pools & Update Settings
Product-wide exclusions
  • Okta Identity Governance · Okta Workflows
  • Live sessions · user-level consent grants · write-only credentials

Per PRD doc 9 v4 §5 (doc 2 §5.1–5.3).
